input.quote: (viii) it is the rightful owner or licensee of all intellectual property rights to the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder;
input.rationale: The Agreement has no IP or data ownership provision. The only IP-adjacent terms are Kubient's warranty that it owns the Service, Auction Platform and "products delivered hereunder" (p0040), a limited, non-transferable, non-sublicensable and expressly revocable platform licence to AP that is revoked on termination (p0002, p0021), and AP's assumption of liability for its Content (p0025). Nothing gives AP any rights in deliverables, and nothing limits Kubient's use of AP's Content, Requests or visitor data to providing the Services. We therefore inserted the playbook fallback: Kubient keeps ownership of its generic tools and know-how (consistent with its retained platform ownership, so no collateral rewrite of p0040 is needed), AP receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for its business, and any Kubient licence in AP data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services. Preferred-level assignment of deliverables was not pursued because it would contradict the retained p0040 warranty; this sits at the fallback.

ops.text: Kubient retains ownership of its generic tools and know-how. Kubient grants Customer a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables provided under this Agreement for Customer's business. Any license granted to Kubient in the Content, Requests or other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer is limited to processing such data solely to provide the Services.
